cause: Migration rollback existed as scripts/files but was not executed as a release-blocking CI proof.
violation: DOC-C §15.1 migration tests + §15.2 rollback-failure build-fail rule; DOC-E E3/E12 proof gap.
impact: A broken down migration could pass normal tests and reach release evidence without detection.
fix: Ephemeral PostgreSQL round-trip proof with exact base/current schema diffs; required attestation/deploy migration_rollback gate.
prevention: Latest migration manifest must pin pre-migration schema SHA and down SQL; CI refuses stale manifest or failed round-trip.
regression: Workflow 35553033907 all validation gates PASS; deploy SKIPPED.
